text:
Carla: Quick draft posted for tomorrow's docs release. Includes SDK snippet cleanups, two redirect fixes, and a Known Issues note about streaming behavior. Please skim.

Jun: looking now. which redirects landed?

Sam: patched /docs/sdk/py/snips -> /docs/sdk/python/snippets and /docs/guides/embed -> /docs/guides/embeddings in PR #4701. Verified on staging.

Ravi: Observed streaming oddity: when fallback routing switches mid-stream some clients see a zero-length chunk. Workaround we should publish: ignore empty frames before parsing.

Jun: can repro with Node and Python samples. Suggest adding both examples.

Carla: added short Node + Python guards under Known Issues. Also shortened top bullets to 3 lines: highlights, fixes, known issue + workaround.

Sam: tiny wording nit: change "small UX polish" -> "docs polish" so readers don't think product changed.

Carla: done.

docs-bot: Merged PRs: #4701, #4710 (changelog copy). Staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-04-02 (expires in 48h).

Ravi: example snippets I used:

```python
# ignore empty streaming chunks
def handle(chunk):
  if not chunk:
    return
  obj = json.loads(chunk)
  # process obj
```

```js
// ignore empty streaming chunks
function handleChunk(chunk) {
  if (!chunk || chunk.length === 0) return;
  const obj = JSON.parse(chunk);
  // process obj
}
```

Jun: added reproduce steps to the internal ticket: enable routing, send long sequence (>512 tokens), and trigger variant flip.

Carla: thanks. I'll publish tomorrow AM unless someone flags an issue by 9:00am PT. :thumbsup:
